blocks.title: Overland transport support for inland and cross-border cargo
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex coordinates overland transport from Mombasa and Nairobi with 10+ partner transporters across East Africa. Our partners operate modern fleets with 24/7 GPS tracking , experienced drivers, and full carrier liability coverage. We specialize in transit cargo along the Northern Corridor (to Uganda, South Sudan) and Central Corridor (to Rwanda, Burundi, DRC).
items: Full Truckload (FTL) – Dedicated trucks for large shipments
Less-than-Truckload (LTL) – Cost-effective consolidation for smaller cargo
24/7 GPS Real-Time Tracking – Full visibility of your shipment from pickup to delivery
Experienced Drivers – Familiar with EAC routes and border procedures
Carrier Liability Available – Comprehensive coverage through partner carriers
Transit Bond Coordination – Seamless customs clearance at borders
Refrigerated Trucks (Reefers) – For perishable goods (on request)

blocks.title: Routes & Transit Times
items: Mombasa → Kampala (Uganda): 3-4 days via Northern Corridor through Malaba / Busia border
Mombasa → Kigali (Rwanda): 5-6 days via Central Corridor through Rusumo / Gatuna border
Mombasa → Bujumbura (Burundi): 7 days via Central Corridor through Rusumo border
Mombasa → Goma/Lubumbashi (DRC): 6-7 days via Central Corridor through Rusumo / Kasumbalesa border
Mombasa → Juba (South Sudan): 7-8 days via Northern Corridor through Nimule border

blocks.title: Road freight cargo types commonly supported
items: General cargo: Cartons, pallets, retail stock, packaged commercial goods and mixed cargo loads
Machinery and equipment: Cargo requiring structured inland handling and route-aware delivery planning
Refrigerated (Reefer) cargo: Temperature-sensitive goods, fresh produce, and perishables
Industrial and project cargo: Inland transport planning for heavier or more complex cargo moving beyond the port or warehouse stage

blocks.title: How the overland transport process works
items: Step 1: Request a quote with cargo details and destination
Step 2: We connect you with the best partner transporter for your route
Step 3: Cargo pickup and transit bond processing
Step 4: Real-time GPS tracking through our partner's system
Step 5: Border clearance and final delivery confirmation

blocks.title: Overland transport questions
items:
How long does overland transport take from Mombasa to Uganda? 
Overland transport from Mombasa to Kampala (Uganda) typically takes 3-4 days via the Northern Corridor through the Malaba or Busia border crossings.

What routes do you use for regional delivery? 
Kenya Tradex uses the Northern Corridor (Mombasa to Uganda, South Sudan) and the Central Corridor (Mombasa to Rwanda, Burundi, DRC) with key border crossings including Malaba, Busia, Rusumo, Gatuna, Kasumbalesa, and Nimule.

Do you offer GPS tracking for overland shipments? 
Yes. Kenya Tradex provides 24/7 GPS tracking for all overland shipments, giving you full visibility from pickup to final delivery.

Do you have refrigerated trucks for perishable cargo? 
Yes. Refrigerated trucks (Reefers) are available on request for temperature-sensitive goods, fresh produce, and perishables.
